source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第七课《司马光》
file_note: The workbook's exercises for 第七课, typed from 练习册A pp. 43–54 (PDF index = printed + 4, verified on p. 43, which opens 第七课 under 星期一). Same shapes as L03–L05: tf/order/slots/match/sort/pick are marked by rule; write is judged stroke by stroke; free is grid writing for the chinese-review skill; read is recorded; speak is the retell, signed by a parent; the 选词填空 exercises are `blocks` naming zh-word items. Wednesday carries two 选词填空 (练习1 and 练习5), so it has two blocks: zb:L07-D3 and zb:L07-D3b, the second suffixed the way L03 suffixed a second site exercise (zx:L03-D5-02b). The three choose-between-printed-options exercises (星期二 练习4, 星期三 练习4, 星期五 练习1) are `pick` exercises per zh4/PICK.md, all items kept. Still out: item (5) of 星期一 练习5 (pinyin in a 米字格; see its scope_note); the passage 《乌鸦喝水》 of 星期五 练习2 (pp. 53–54, the workbook's own) is not typed — the site holds no text of the book, by the owner's decision of 2 October (docs/chinese.md § 8) — and its four true/false sentences are kept; the listening script on p. 83 is not typed.

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks
blocks.scope_note: The book offers five words (花园 惊慌 只有 小心 扑通) for five sentences, one each. Each item carries four of them — the one left off is a word the sentence's grammar or the book's one-word-per-blank pairing already rules out — so the task she faces is the book's: which of the box fills this blank.

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks
blocks.scope_note: pp. 50–51. The box is 上来 下来 进来 出来 回来, one per sentence, under the example 水缸破了，水流了出来。 Each item carries four of the five; the one left off is the word that would also read sensibly in that sentence once the book's one-word-per-blank pairing is forgotten (回来 in (2) and (4); 出来 in (3), where 你在哪里呀？快点出来吧 is what a child says in hide-and-seek, and in (5)), so no item has two defensible answers. (1) leaves off 上来.

blocks.title: 选词填空，填写序号
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words and fill in the blanks with the numbers
blocks.scope_note: One paragraph retelling the 课文 with five blanks and a numbered box (①水缸 ②惊慌 ③吓哭 ④花园 ⑤扑通). On the site she picks the word rather than writing its number. Each item carries four of the five; in (4) 惊慌 is left off because 别的小朋友都惊慌了 would also be a sentence — the book saves 惊慌 for the last blank.

exercises.title: 描一描，写一写
exercises.title_en: Trace and write

note.zh: 看旁边的词想字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: The word beside the box tells you the character; write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

exercises.context_note: The page prints the eight characters to trace with no word beside them; each context word is taken from the textbook's 词语 and 读一读 (pp. 73, 75), as L03 and L04 did.

explanation.zh: 司马：sī。
explanation.en: 司马 — sī, as in Sima Guang.

explanation.zh: 聪明：cōng。
explanation.en: 聪明 — cōng, clever.

explanation.zh: 扑通：pū。
explanation.en: 扑通 — pū, splash.

explanation.zh: 水缸：gāng。
explanation.en: 水缸 — gāng, a water vat.

explanation.zh: 装满：zhuāng。
explanation.en: 装满 — zhuāng, filled up.

explanation.zh: 惊慌：huāng。
explanation.en: 惊慌 — huāng, panic.

explanation.zh: 使劲：jìn。
explanation.en: 使劲 — jìn, use all your strength.

explanation.zh: 砸缸：zá。
explanation.en: 砸缸 — zá, smash the vat.

exercises.title: 左右结构、上下结构，还是半包围结构？
exercises.title_en: Left–right, top–bottom, or half-enclosed?
exercises.scope_note: The book prints three lines under the eight characters — 左右结构, 上下结构, 半包围结构 — for her to sort them onto. 司 is keyed 半包围结构 from the page itself: the book offers that group, and none of the other seven can go in it (six are plainly left–right and 装 is top–bottom).

explanation.zh: 司的第一笔横折钩从上面和右边包住里面的一和口：半包围结构。这八个字里只有它是。
explanation.en: 司's first stroke hooks over the top and down the right, around 一 and 口 inside: half-enclosed. It is the only one of the eight.

explanation.zh: 耳在左、总在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 耳 on the left, 总 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 扌在左、卜在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 扌 on the left, 卜 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 缶在左、工在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 缶 on the left, 工 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 壮在上、衣在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 壮 above, 衣 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 忄在左、荒在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 忄 on the left, 荒 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 力在右边，另一半在左边：左右结构。
explanation.en: 力 on the right, the other half on the left: left–right.

explanation.zh: 石在左、匝在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 石 on the left, 匝 on the right: left–right.

exercises.title: 找朋友，连成字
exercises.title_en: Look for friends, make characters

note.zh: 先点上面的部件，再点下面能和它合成字的那一半。课本已连好一组：氵—去。
note.en: Tap a part on the top row, then the half below that makes a character with it. The book has drawn one line already: 氵—去.

explanation.zh: 口和下合成"吓"。
explanation.en: 口 and 下 make 吓.

explanation.zh: 扌和卜合成"扑"。
explanation.en: 扌 and 卜 make 扑.

explanation.zh: 氵和去合成"法"——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 氵 and 去 make 法 — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 亻和吏合成"使"。
explanation.en: 亻 and 吏 make 使.

explanation.zh: 石和匝合成"砸"。
explanation.en: 石 and 匝 make 砸.

explanation.zh: 耳和总合成"聪"。
explanation.en: 耳 and 总 make 聪.

exercises.title_en: Look for friends: write the characters and form words

note.zh: 连线在前面做过了；这里把五个字各写一遍，再各组一个词。课本已写好一个：法 → 办法。
note.en: The matching was done on the site; here write each of the five characters once and make one word with each. The book has done one already: 法 → 办法.

exercises.title: 根据拼音写汉字
exercises.title_en: Write characters below Pinyin

note.zh: 读音相同或相近，字不一样——看括号旁边的字想词。
note.en: Same or similar sound, different characters — the character beside the blank tells you the word.

explanation.zh: 学习：xí。
explanation.en: 学习 — xí, study.

explanation.zh: 喜欢：xǐ。
explanation.en: 喜欢 — xǐ, like.

explanation.zh: 游戏：xì。
explanation.en: 游戏 — xì, game.

explanation.zh: 吓哭了：xià。

explanation.zh: 下课：xià。
explanation.en: 下课 — xià, class is over.

explanation.zh: 夏天：xià。
explanation.en: 夏天 — xià, summer.

explanation.zh: 使劲：jìn。
explanation.en: 使劲 — jìn, use all your strength.

explanation.zh: 今天：jīn。
explanation.en: 今天 — jīn, today.

explanation.zh: 进出：jìn。
explanation.en: 进出 — jìn, go in and out.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语
exercises.title_en: Match to form words

note.zh: 先点上面的字，再点下面能和它组成词的字。课本已连好一组：只—有。
note.en: Tap a character on the top row, then the one below that makes a word with it. The book has drawn one line already: 只—有.

explanation.zh: 使—劲：使劲。
explanation.en: 使 + 劲 = 使劲, use all your strength.

explanation.zh: 只—有：只有——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 只 + 有 = 只有, only — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 惊—慌：惊慌。
explanation.en: 惊 + 慌 = 惊慌, panic.

explanation.zh: 办—法：办法。
explanation.en: 办 + 法 = 办法, a way to deal with something.

explanation.zh: 扑—通：扑通。
explanation.en: 扑 + 通 = 扑通, splash.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语：把词写下来
exercises.title_en: Match to form words: write the words

note.zh: 连线在前面做过了；这里把四个词各写一遍（课本已写好：只有）。
note.en: The matching was done on the site; here write each of the four words once (the book has written 只有 already).

exercises.title: 填写正确答案
exercises.title_en: Fill in the correct answers

note.zh: 每题有两个空，把答案写在格子里；笔画数用汉字写，比如"九"。
note.en: Each line has two blanks; write the answers in the cells, and write a stroke count in characters, such as 九.

exercises.scope_note: The book's item (5) — "块"的读音是____，第三画是____ — is left out: its first blank asks for pinyin (kuài), and a grid of 米字格 is no place for pinyin, as L04 decided for 模. Its second blank would be 提 (土 on the left of a character is written 横、竖、提).
exercises.answers_note: Keys for the reviewer, worked out from the characters and the textbook (no key is printed anywhere): (1) 部首 衣 — p. 72 prints 衣 → 装 — and 12 strokes (丬3 + 士3 + 衣6); (2) 口 on the left, 下 on the right; (3) 12 strokes (忄3 + 艹3 + 亡3 + 川-shaped part 3), and the 12th, the last stroke of 荒, is 竖弯钩; (4) 部首 口, 10 strokes (口口6 + 犬4) — 口 is how 新华字典 files 哭, though the book itself prints no radical for it.

items.prompt_en: (1) The radical of 装 is ＿＿, and it has ＿＿ strokes in all.
(2) The left side of 吓 is ＿＿, and the right side is ＿＿.
(3) 慌 has ＿＿ strokes in all, and the twelfth stroke is ＿＿.

items.prompt: （4）"哭"是上下结构，部首是＿＿，一共＿＿画。
items.prompt_en: (4) 哭 is a top–bottom character; its radical is ＿＿, and it has ＿＿ strokes in all.

exercises.title: 读一读
exercises.title_en: Read aloud

note.zh: 读出来，录下来就行，不打分。对照在批改的时候看。
note.en: Just read it aloud; it is recorded, not scored. The comparison is for the evaluation.

exercises.text:
上来 下来 出来 进来 回来
妈妈从房子里走出来了。我从万寿山上走下来。
快回来吧，我们等你吃饭呢。外面下雨了，你进来吧。
月亮掉到水里了，我们把它捞上来吧。

exercises.title: 连一连
exercises.title_en: Match

note.zh: 四张图在练习册第46页，标着A、B、C、D。先点词语，再点它说的那张图。课本已连好一组：石头—B。
note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 46, lettered A to D. Tap a word, then the picture it names. The book has drawn one line already: 石头—B.

explanation.zh: 一堆石头——图B，课本给的例子。
explanation.en: A pile of stones — picture B, the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 开满了花的花坛——图D。
explanation.en: A bed full of flowers — picture D.

explanation.zh: "扑通"是东西掉进水里的声音——图C是溅起来的水花。
explanation.en: 扑通 is the sound of something falling into water — picture C is the splash.

explanation.zh: 男孩双手捧着脸、张大了嘴，又吃惊又害怕——图A。
explanation.en: The boy with his hands on his cheeks and his mouth wide open, startled and scared — picture A.

exercises.title: 词语连线并造句
exercises.title_en: Match to form words and make sentences

note.zh: 先点左边的字，再点右边能和它组成词的字。课本已连好一组：办—法。
note.en: Tap a character on the left, then the one on the right that makes a word with it. The book has drawn one line already: 办—法.

explanation.zh: 聪—明：聪明。
explanation.en: 聪 + 明 = 聪明, clever.

explanation.zh: 惊—慌：惊慌。
explanation.en: 惊 + 慌 = 惊慌, panic.

explanation.zh: 办—法：办法——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 办 + 法 = 办法, a way to deal with something — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 使—劲：使劲。
explanation.en: 使 + 劲 = 使劲, use all your strength.

exercises.title: 词语连线并造句：造句
exercises.title_en: Match to form words and make sentences: the sentences

note.zh: 连线在前面做过了。课本已写好第（1）句：我想到了一个好办法。用另外三个词各造一个句子。
note.en: The matching was done on the site. The book has written sentence (1): 我想到了一个好办法。 Make one sentence with each of the other three words.

exercises.scope_note: The book's lines (2)–(4) do not say which word goes on which line; they are given here in the order of the left-hand column, 办法 aside.

exercises.title: 给正确的词语涂色
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct words and color

note.zh: 每句选一个对的词。（练习册上是给它涂上颜色。）
note.en: Pick the right word for each sentence. (In the workbook you color it in.)

explanation.zh: "想出"来的是办法：想出了一个好办法。"希望"是心里盼着的事，不是想出来的。
explanation.en: What you think up is a way to solve something — 办法. 希望 is a hope, not something you work out.

explanation.zh: 后面有"才"，前面就用"只有"：只有……才……。"只要"跟的是"就"。
explanation.en: 才 later in the sentence pairs with 只有: 只有……才…… means only if … can. 只要 pairs with 就.

items.text: （3）我们都是（　）的孩子，都能学好汉语。

explanation.zh: 能学好汉语，说的是聪明：我们都是聪明的孩子。"小心"是留神，跟学得好没有关系。
explanation.en: Learning Chinese well goes with being clever — 聪明. 小心 means careful, which is not what makes you learn well.

explanation.zh: 要砸破又大又深的水缸，得用大力气：课文里说他使劲向水缸砸去。
explanation.en: To break a big, deep vat you have to hit hard — the text says he smashed it 使劲, with all his strength.

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：同学们从教室里走出来。
explanation.en: In order: 同学们从教室里走出来 — the classmates walk out of the classroom.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：只有司马光不惊慌。
explanation.en: In order: 只有司马光不惊慌 — only Sima Guang does not panic.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：树下有一个大水缸。
explanation.en: In order: 树下有一个大水缸 — under the tree there is a big water vat.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：他真是个聪明的孩子。这里的"真"是在感叹整句话——他真是个聪明的孩子！所以它放在"是"前面，不放进"聪明的孩子"里。
explanation.en: In order: 他真是个聪明的孩子 — he really is a clever child. Here 真 exclaims about the whole sentence, so it goes before 是, not inside 聪明的孩子.

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误
exercises.title_en: Decide whether the sentences are true or false according to the text

items.text: 小朋友们在花园里面玩儿，没有听见有人“扑通”一声掉进水缸的声音。

explanation.zh: 课文里说：突然，大家听到“扑通”一声。大家都听见了。
explanation.en: The text says 大家听到“扑通”一声 — everyone heard the splash.

items.text: 水缸又大又深，装满了水。

explanation.zh: 课文里说：水缸又大又深，里面装满了水。
explanation.en: The text says so: 水缸又大又深，里面装满了水 — the vat was big and deep and full of water.

items.text: 小朋友们都哭了，司马光也很惊慌。

explanation.zh: 别的小朋友都吓哭了，只有司马光不惊慌。
explanation.en: The other children cried with fright, but only Sima Guang did not panic: 只有司马光不惊慌.

items.text: 司马光找来一块大石头，使劲向水缸砸去。

explanation.zh: 这就是他想出的办法：找来一块大石头，使劲向水缸砸去。
explanation.en: That was his idea: he found a big stone and smashed it hard against the vat.

items.text: 司马光是个聪明的孩子。

explanation.zh: 课文第一句就说他是一个聪明的孩子；最后大家都说："司马光真聪明！"
explanation.en: The first line calls him a clever child, and at the end everyone says 司马光真聪明 — how clever Sima Guang is.

exercises.title: 选择相应的句子补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct sentences to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 对话里缺了四句，司马光说三句，小朋友说一句。对话从练习册第49页接到第50页。
note.en: Four lines are missing: three for Sima Guang and one for the children. The dialogue runs from workbook p. 49 onto p. 50.

options: 大家别慌，我来想想办法！
好啊，但是大家要小心一点儿。

items.before: 小朋友：我们一起去花园里玩儿吧！

explanation.zh: 朋友叫他一起去玩儿，他答应了，还提醒大家：好啊，但是大家要小心一点儿。
explanation.en: Asked to come and play, he agrees and reminds everyone to be careful: 好啊，但是大家要小心一点儿.

items.before: （司马光正在和小朋友们玩耍。）小朋友：快来人啊，有人掉到水缸里面了！　司马光：______啊，我想出来了！

explanation.zh: 有人掉进了水缸，他先让大家别慌，再想办法——后面的"啊，我想出来了！"就是想出了办法。
explanation.en: Someone has fallen into the vat; he first tells everyone not to panic and to let him think — then 啊，我想出来了, he has the idea.

explanation.zh: 他的办法要用大石头：快帮我找一块大石头。下一行小朋友就拿来了大石头。
explanation.en: His idea needs a big stone: 快帮我找一块大石头. In the next line the children bring one.

items.before: （小朋友拿来了大石头，司马光拿起石头使劲向水缸砸去。）

explanation.zh: 水缸砸破了，大家夸他：太好了！你真聪明啊！
explanation.en: The vat breaks, and the children praise him: 太好了！你真聪明啊！

exercises.title: 根据课文选择正确的答案，并涂上你喜欢的颜色
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct answers according to the text and color with your favorite color

note.zh: 根据课文选一个答案。（练习册上还要给选中的王冠涂上你喜欢的颜色。）
note.en: Choose the answer from the text. (In the workbook you also color the crown beside it.)

explanation.zh: 课文里说，他和小朋友们在花园里玩儿。
explanation.en: The text says they were playing in the garden: 在花园里玩儿.

explanation.zh: 出的事是：有个小朋友不小心从树上掉进了水缸。有的孩子在爬树，那只是在玩儿。
explanation.en: What happened is that a child slipped from the tree into the vat. Some children were climbing trees, but that was only their game.

explanation.zh: 他找来一块大石头，使劲向水缸砸去。课文里没有去叫大人。
explanation.en: He found a big stone and smashed the vat with it; in the text nobody runs for a grown-up.

explanation.zh: 水缸破了，水流了出来，那个小朋友得救了。
explanation.en: The vat broke, the water ran out, and the child was saved: 得救了.

exercises.title: 连一连
exercises.title_en: Match

note.zh: 左边是问题，右边是回答。先点问题，再点它的回答。
note.en: Questions on the left, answers on the right. Tap a question, then its answer.

right: 因为有人掉到水缸里了。

explanation.zh: 问"为什么"，答"因为……"：有人掉进了水缸，司马光砸缸是为了救他。
explanation.en: A why-question takes a because-answer: someone had fallen into the vat, and Sima Guang broke it to save him.

explanation.zh: 问"用什么"，答的是用的东西：大石头。
explanation.en: Asked what he used, the answer names the thing: a big stone.

explanation.zh: 问"……了吗"，答"救出了"：水流了出来，那个小朋友得救了。
explanation.en: A yes-or-no question about the rescue: yes — the water ran out and the child was saved.

exercises.title: 根据课文回答问题
exercises.title_en: Answer the questions according to the text

items.prompt: 司马光和小朋友们遇到了什么问题？

exercises.title: 把故事讲给爸爸妈妈听，考考他们
exercises.title_en: Tell the story to your parents and test them

question.zh: "司马光砸缸"告诉了我们什么道理？
question.en: What does the story of Sima Guang breaking the vat teach us?

note.zh: 把故事讲一遍，录下来；讲完问爸爸妈妈这个问题，再请他们点一下"家长已听"。
note.en: Tell the story and it is recorded; then ask your parents the question, and have them tap Listened.

exercises.title: 根据录音回答问题
exercises.title_en: Listen and answer the questions

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读一读练习册第83页附录里第7课的听力文本（或放录音），听完再选。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 7 listening script in the appendix on workbook p. 83 (or play the recording), then choose.

exercises.scope_note: pp. 52–53; the script (附录 听力文本, 第7课, p. 83) is not typed. Item (2) is kept: the script names the picnic party as 爸爸妈妈 + 我 + 弟弟, and the book's own question (1) calls that party 我们家, so the count is four; 三 and 五 have nothing in the script to rest on.

explanation.zh: 录音一开头就说了：是星期日去公园野餐的。
explanation.en: The recording says it at the very start: the picnic was on Sunday.

explanation.zh: 录音里去野餐的是爸爸、妈妈、我和弟弟，第（1）题说这是"我们家"去野餐：一共四口人。
explanation.en: The picnic party in the recording is Dad, Mom, me and my little brother, and question (1) calls them 我们家, our family: four people.

explanation.zh: 录音里说，他们九点就出发了。
explanation.en: The recording says they set off at nine o'clock.

explanation.zh: 到了公园，他们看见的是草地和花朵。
explanation.en: At the park they saw grass and flowers.

explanation.zh: 录音里说，他们一起放风筝，玩得非常开心。
explanation.en: The recording says they flew a kite together and had a great time.

exercises.title: 读短文，判断对错
exercises.title_en: Read the passage and decide whether the statements are true or false

note.zh: 短文《乌鸦喝水》在练习册第53–54页。先读短文，再判断对错。
note.en: The passage 乌鸦喝水 is on workbook pp. 53–54. Read it first, then mark each sentence.

exercises.scope_note: The passage is the workbook's own and is not typed (file_note). The four sentences are on p. 54, under its last paragraph.

explanation.zh: 短文一开头，乌鸦就渴了，正到处找水。
explanation.en: Right at the start of the passage the crow is thirsty and out looking for water.

explanation.zh: 瓶子里面有半瓶水，只是乌鸦喝不着。
explanation.en: The bottle was half full of water; the crow just could not reach it.

explanation.zh: 短文里说乌鸦"喝不着"——"喝不着"就是"喝不到"。
explanation.en: The passage says the crow 喝不着 — and 喝不着 means the same as 喝不到, could not get a drink.

explanation.zh: 最后乌鸦用小石子让水升高，喝到了水。
explanation.en: In the end the crow used pebbles to make the water rise, and it did get its drink.
